# Synthetic DBCs, generated by gen_golden.py as a systematic sweep over byte
# order, signedness, length, bit alignment and scaling.
#
# The tests deliberately do NOT use the DBCs under dbcs/. Those evolve for
# product reasons, and pinning decoded values from them would mean adding a
# signal to a vendor file broke a parser test. These inputs never change, so
# their goldens never need regenerating.
generate_dbc_code(dbc_test_layout ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dbcs/dbc_test_layout.dbc)
generate_dbc_code(dbc_test_scaling ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dbcs/dbc_test_scaling.dbc)
generate_dbc_code(dbc_test_features ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dbcs/dbc_test_features.dbc)

# Differential test against cantools, over the synthetic sweep.
add_executable(dbc_parser_test_golden
    test_golden.cpp
)

target_include_directories(dbc_parser_test_golden PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

target_link_libraries(dbc_parser_test_golden
    PRIVATE
    dbc_test_layout
    dbc_test_scaling
    dbc_test_features
)

add_project_test(TARGET dbc_parser_test_golden LABELS dbc_parser unit)

# Frame length checks, handler registration and multiplex gating -- behaviour
# the differential test cannot observe, since it only compares numbers.
add_executable(dbc_parser_test_generated_api
    test_generated_api.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(dbc_parser_test_generated_api
    PRIVATE
    dbc_test_features
)

add_project_test(TARGET dbc_parser_test_generated_api LABELS dbc_parser unit)

# Bad input, and what the parser must say about it. Parser only, embedded
# strings, no files.
add_executable(dbc_parser_test_malformed
    test_malformed.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(dbc_parser_test_malformed
    PRIVATE
    dbc::parser
)

add_project_test(TARGET dbc_parser_test_malformed LABELS dbc_parser unit)

# The shape of the generated text -- escaping, enumerator naming, which C++
# type a signal gets. Drives the generator in process from embedded DBC
# strings, so it needs no files and no compiler.
add_executable(dbc_parser_test_codegen
    test_codegen.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(dbc_parser_test_codegen
    PRIVATE
    dbc::codegen
)

add_project_test(TARGET dbc_parser_test_codegen LABELS dbc_parser unit)
